name: Linh Phan
bio: Linh spends her weekday mornings reviewing logistics dashboards at a mid-size consumer goods company before her first coffee even cools down. On weekends she and her girlfriend take turns picking a new drive-through spot on the outskirts of town, rating each place's slushies with a seriousness that makes their friends laugh. She recently started restoring a vintage moped she found at an estate sale, though she has no mechanical background and mostly learns from YouTube. Her apartment is filled with potted herbs she insists on growing herself, even the ones that keep dying in the low winter light.
